result.title: From Likelihood Convergence to Parameter Convergence in POMDPs
result.summary: Likelihood-based methods are widely used to learn the parameters of partially observable Markov decision processes (POMDPs). While finite-sample guarantees for policy suboptimality exist for certain POMDP subclasses, analogous guarantees for parameter recovery remain less well understood. For any candidate POMDP parameter, we bound its parameter recovery error in terms of its likelihood gap to the ground truth, the structural conditioning of the observation and transition kernels, and the behavior policy used to collect data. The bound applies in both the undercomplete and overcomplete regimes, with the latter following naturally from the undercomplete analysis. Because the result applies to any sufficiently good candidate, it yields finite-sample guarantees for the maximum-likelihood estimator and any procedure producing a parameter with controlled likelihood gap. This is particularly useful for near-optimal learning in infinite-horizon POMDPs, where existing approaches largely rely on model-based planning with accurate transition and observation kernel estimates. The bound separates the contributions of the behavior policy and model, showing how data-collection choices, including action coverage, and their effects on mixing can accelerate parameter learning.

AI.brief_summary: 该文研究 POMDP 的似然式参数学习，将参数恢复误差上界表示为与真实模型的似然差、观测与转移核的结构条件数以及数据采集行为策略的函数，并为 MLE 等低似然差估计给出有限样本保证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其关于「似然拟合不等于潜在状态参数恢复」以及行为策略覆盖与混合影响潜在恢复的结论，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态的可辨识性、轨迹数据分布与监督信号设计，但并非直接的视觉推理工作。
